notes.title: Work in Progress 13
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
The cool weather is finally here, and my PC is no longer competing with an oven! As I mentioned earlier, I’m in full swing with the project. I’ve completed the third week of writing and programming, and I’m already working on the fourth and final week. Unfortunately, rendering is just now picking up pace, so I’ll assess how many images from the third week I can recover. If I fall behind on the fourth week (in terms of text and programming), I might consider updating the third week as usual; otherwise, I’ll push through to the end with the multiple endings I’m writing.

[b]Week 3:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]    Graphics: 40%
[*]     Text: 100%
[*]     Programming: 100%[/i]
[/list]

[b]Week 4:[/b]
[i][list]
[*] Graphics: 0%
[*] Text: 30%
[*] Programming: 20%
[/list][/i]

However, I can give you an idea of what I plan for the game’s ending. The update for the game’s ending won’t be the final update, but an important milestone. After that, I plan to refine the two current languages, revise them thoroughly, and add achievements. In a subsequent update, I’ll address any bugs reported on the Steam forum.

If there are significant purchase statistics, I might consider adding a couple of additional languages. If the game receives a positive response, I could add an extra section—a sort of sandbox mode—accessible after completing the game once. In this mode, players will be free to interact with and combine the game’s characters without a main storyline. I might also look into periodically adding new characters to this section.

While this project is ambitious, I hope to complete it well and as quickly as possible, even though I’m working alone. As always, thank you for taking the time to follow my updates and for your continued support.

See you soon and thanks again!

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I'm thrilled to announce the first game update! Wondering what's new? Well, I've been working tirelessly to introduce the second week of gameplay, offering a wider range of paths for each of you to explore. Additionally, I've spent time addressing some issues encountered in the first week, revising and partially modifying and enriching the paths of characters like Mai, Alex, Nora, and Megan. Some have been made smoother, while others have been enriched with new interactions. However, it's worth noting that these changes may cause incompatibility with previous saves, and I sincerely apologize for this. Nonetheless, I hope you'll appreciate the new additions!
I've also reviewed some images and part of the translations [i](excluding the introduction, which will be addressed later[/i]). In the extra content, I've included some works done with AI, and if you like the format, I may consider further updating the galleries this way. Please let me know your thoughts!

Now, I'll take a week off and use April to address any reported bugs. In more severe cases, I'll release updates to fix them. Starting May 1st, I'll resume bi-weekly updates to keep you informed about the development of the third week. I hope to publish the second update by the end of August, but please understand that I can't guarantee it at the moment, as I'm the sole workforce behind this project ([i]which isn't even my primary job[/i]).

The game now spans two weeks, equivalent to 14 nights. If you're skillful, you'll organize your evenings without overlapping appointments, leaving space for just two nights at the club. I recommend focusing on one of the local girls and continuing to interact with her, as this could lead to pleasant surprises in the third week. That said, you're free to explore all the paths you desire, keeping in mind that events in the office and certain rooms may influence story development.

[b]Thank you again for your support, and I sincerely hope you'll appreciate the work done so far. 
Keep following us for further updates![/b]

notes.title: Work in Progress 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
as promised, I'm keeping you updated on the game's development with our usual biweekly report. Currently, I'm focusing my efforts on the "second week," a chapter filled with intriguing developments for our protagonists' stories. Here's a preview of what you can expect:
[list]
[*]     Discovery of Mai's blackmailers and their evolutions.
[*]     The first direct encounter between the Mc and Lucy.
[*]     Mc's first date with Alex.
[*]     The first face-to-face meeting between Mc and Rudy.
[*]     Mc's initial appointment with Nora.
[*]     Evolution of the storyline between Mc and Megan.
[*]     A secret meeting between Renee and Mc.
[/list]

Currently, the progress status of the update is as follows:
[list]
[*]     GRAPHICS: 40%
[*]     TEXT: 40%
[*]     PROGRAMMING: 30%
[/list]
I am working diligently to ensure good graphics, engaging texts, and programming to enhance the gaming experience. In the latest game update, I will have a native speaker review all the texts for a more accurate translation between English and Italian, and I will assess the integration of other languages. I believe the current priority is to complete the game as a whole.

Furthermore, I would like to inform you that soon you will find on the [url=https://prowebline.wixsite.com/summerwitch]official game website[/url]  in the FORUM section a detailed description of what the final game represents, along with in-depth guides on ongoing stories. I want to ensure that the community is fully engaged and informed about every aspect of  project.

[i]Stay tuned for further updates, and thank you for your continuous support![/i]
